## What is an agent?

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- A language model with tools. It reads files, writes code, runs it, and
  loops until a check passes
- Claude Code, Codex and similar, in a terminal
- Not an agent-based model. Those simulate individuals
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
![](figures/agents-agent-1.png){width="100%"
fig-alt="A brick box on the left, you, a prompt, feeds a loop of four
boxes, read the files and the docs, write or change code, run it, check
passed. No returns to the top. Yes leads to a pull request and a brick
box, you, read it, merge or send back."}
